S01: In ancient China, high above the winding rivers, lived the water god Gong Gong.
S02: His duty was to give a name to every lake and every river.
S03: But the list had no end, and the task was terribly dull.
S04: Gong Gong: "I can bear this no longer, Xiangliu."
S05: Xiangliu: "Nor I, my lord. Every day the same."
S06: Gong Gong: "Why should we not rebel? Let us make tsunamis and floods!"
S07: Gong Gong: "We shall have such fun!"
S08: The two rose up, and the sky suddenly darkened.
S10: And they set out to turn the world upside down.
S12: Tsunamis swallowed fields, and the rivers burst their banks.
S13: Gong Gong: "Ha! Watch how the world flees!"
S14: The villages and fields sank beneath the risen waters.
S17: But then the clouds split open, and a strong light descended from the sky.
S18: From the clouds on his tiger descended Zhu Rong, the god of fire.
S23: Gong Gong: "And what will you do to me if I do not stop?"
S31: Xiangliu fell defeated, and her game was over.
S33: I must surrender, thought Gong Gong.
S34: But his wrath was stronger, and he flew at the sacred pillar.
S35: The sacred mountain Buzhou — the pillar that held the Earth apart from the Sky.
S36: And with all his strength he struck it with his head.
S39: The rock split open beneath the blow.
S42: Rocks and stones tumbled down like an enormous waterfall.
S43: Gong Gong realized he had gone too far.
S46: So he fled and hid in the deep waters.
S48: From that day, he always avoided Zhu Rong and his fiery sword.
